content_sections.heading: ICMR-NIRWoH Senior Consultant - Hindi/Rajbhashya Job Description
content_sections.text: Assist in the effective implementation of the Government of India Official Language Policy in the Institute. Prepare Hindi quarterly progress reports of the Institute. Translate the Institute's annual report and other documents into Hindi. Prepare reports and necessary details regarding the inspection questionnaire of the Parliamentary Committee on Official Language. Translate various forms, circulars, manuals, articles, office orders, letters, and other documents from Hindi to English and English to Hindi. Prepare official correspondence, office orders, office notes, and drafts on computer in Hindi. Provide assistance to the Institute's Hindi Committee in activities relating to Official Language implementation. Assist the In-charge Rajbhasha Officer in the implementation of the Official Language Policy and related official work. Assist in organising Hindi workshops, training programmes, and events such as Hindi Pakhwada. Assist in the compliance of work and recommendations related to the Town Official Language Implementation Committee (TOLIC / नराकास). Perform any other related tasks assigned by the competent authority from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: For retired government employees, remuneration is fixed as per Ministry of Finance, Department of Expenditure office memorandum 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09-12-2020. Full time, contractual basis
